name: Harvest Blues
source:
It's finally autumn, and Koharu has some mixed feelings about that. Enjoy a short reflection on the coming season, pick out a cute sweater, make some cider, and chat with your partner!

[From [url=https://frandszk.itch.io/harvest-blues]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
秋天终于来了，小春的心情有些复杂。享受这段关于迎接新季节的短暂思绪吧：挑一件可爱的毛衣，酿些苹果酒，再和伴侣聊聊天！

[来源：[url=https://frandszk.itch.io/harvest-blues]itch.io[/url]]
